observations: A source-readiness-first selector precommit prevented post-read source, schema, threshold, query, and budget drift while still permitting bounded public-data evidence.
Exact source identity and high key overlap did not imply exact semantic equivalence: 29 overlapping alpha-2 keys retained distinct nonempty normalized names and required explicit attribution.
Invalid-key and conflicting-duplicate controls plus canonical replay materially strengthened the bounded reconciliation receipt without activating a Candidate or mutating upstream systems.
